searchText: for geth archive node, * how much SSD do you need? * how much HDD? * for the SSD, do you need NVMe, or will SATA speeds suffice? I'm syncing a geth archive node right now. It's still 1year7months behind the tip of the chain and consuming 2.7 TB of disk. I'm expecting it to be close 6-7TB by the time it is fully synced. Disk is 3x 4TB SSD's in a logical volume. sorry, I should've been clearer -- I know how much an archive node weighs (https://etherscan.io/chartsync/chainarchive), what I wonder is how much of that can I store on the HDD. To the best of my knowledge, geth is going to need all of it on fast disk because it is just one massive leveldb database and there's no distinction between archive state and recent active state (it all lives in done database) There's the ancient DB but I'm not sure how much if any of the archive state is moved to there, I can check on Monday. ugh. now please tell me it needn't be all NVMe's... thanks Ryan, that would be quite helpful for me. Ancient dB doesn't house state data to the best of my knowledge
